summary: Warren County, MO towersite of 1942; pole tower 1943, steel tower 1950 (sources give 60, 70 or 125 ft); last entry FY 1977-78; no source says if it still stands.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower with a 14 ft by 14 ft cab and a 4 ft catwalk, per 1950 newspapers; it replaced an earlier pole tower
facts.status_note: No source read says whether the tower still stands. The latest entry is a fiscal 1977-78 maintenance note.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Three figures: 60 ft in the FY 1949-50 annual report, 70 ft in the August and September 1950 newspapers, and about 125 ft in the 1970 USGS station description. The story reports all three and does not choose. The record's 18.3 m matches only the 60-ft figure.

notes_for_editor: Record height 18.3 m (60 ft) is one of three conflicting figures, so no correction proposed. Name: the 1950 articles say Daniel Boone Memorial Forest; the current MDC page is for the Daniel Boone Conservation Area. The story does not assert they are the same land. No source after FY 1977-78 found; two web searches turned up nothing about the tower's present state. Fetch budget overrun by a few reads of the same pages. No photos found.
